mechanism: Both drugs have nephrotoxic potential; sacubitril's active metabolite sacubitrilat and tobramycin (aminoglycoside) both concentrate in renal tubules and can cause acute kidney injury, particularly in volume-depleted or already compromised renal function.
action: Monitor serum creatinine and eGFR closely; ensure adequate hydration; consider alternative antibiotic if possible; if combination necessary, use lowest effective tobramycin dose with therapeutic drug monitoring.
